title: The Messengership Of Prophet Muhammad 16th Degree 1st Proof Morality And Miracles

questions.question: What did the traveler decide to do first while searching for his Lord through creation?
questions.answer: He decided to go first to the most outstanding human being among creation and learn from him.

questions.question: Who was the person the traveler chose to visit in his mind?
questions.answer: He chose Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What reasons are given for choosing him before all others?
questions.answer: He is described as the most famous, most accomplished, most respected even by enemies, strongest in speech, and brightest in understanding.

questions.question: What effect did the Prophet have on history according to the passage?
questions.answer: By Allah’s permission, he lit up fourteen centuries through his character and through the Qur’an.

questions.question: How did the age of the Prophet appear to the traveler when he entered it in his mind?
questions.answer: It appeared as a time of true happiness and blessing.

questions.question: What change did the Prophet bring to a people who had been uneducated and uncivilized?
questions.answer: He raised them into leaders and teachers for the world.

questions.question: Before asking about the Creator, what two things did the traveler want to learn about the Prophet?
questions.answer: He wanted to know his rank and worth, and whether his words and warnings were completely true.

questions.question: How many broad proofs does the passage say were found for this investigation?
questions.answer: It says there were nine major proofs, though only the first is discussed here.

questions.question: According to the first proof, what kind of personal qualities did the Prophet have?
questions.answer: He had the finest character and the highest qualities.

questions.question: Whose testimony is mentioned to support his excellent character?
questions.answer: Even his enemies are said to have recognized it.

questions.question: What kinds of signs are mentioned as evidence for his truthfulness?
questions.answer: Many miracles are mentioned, supported by Qur’anic verses and widely transmitted reports.

questions.question: Name one miracle from the passage.
questions.answer: One example is the splitting of the moon.

questions.question: Name a second miracle from the passage.
questions.answer: Another is that dust he threw reached the enemy and caused them to retreat.

questions.question: Name a third miracle from the passage.
questions.answer: Water flowed from his fingers and satisfied a thirsty army.

questions.question: Why does the passage say a person with such character and miracles could not be a liar?
questions.answer: Because someone so noble and clearly supported by miracles would not fall into low actions like deceit, falsehood, or mistake.

questions.question: What was the traveler’s goal in this part of the passage?
questions.answer: He was trying to find his Master and Creator.

questions.question: By what route was he making this search?
questions.answer: He was searching through the creatures in the universe.

questions.question: Why did he think he should begin with Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him?
questions.answer: He saw him as the greatest and most distinguished among creation.

questions.question: What does the passage say even opponents admitted about the Prophet?
questions.answer: They admitted his greatness, intelligence, and high standing.

questions.question: What two things are said to have spread his influence across many centuries?
questions.answer: His personal excellence and the Qur’an.

questions.question: What was special about the period the traveler imagined entering?
questions.answer: It was blessed and joyful because of the Prophet’s presence and mission.

questions.question: What transformation of society is used as proof of the Prophet’s impact?
questions.answer: A rough and unlearned people became guides and instructors for others.

questions.question: What did the traveler say must be examined before asking the Prophet about the Creator?
questions.answer: His true worth and whether his speech and warnings could be trusted.

questions.question: What is the focus of the first proof?
questions.answer: The first proof centers on the Prophet’s noble character and his miracles.

questions.question: What does “tawatur” mean in the note given in the passage?
questions.answer: It means a report passed on by so many people that doubt about it does not remain.

questions.question: Why is tawatur important in this discussion?
questions.answer: It strengthens confidence that the reported miracles are real and trustworthy.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention that more than three hundred miracles exist but does not explain all of them?
questions.answer: It says those details are discussed elsewhere, so this passage gives only brief examples.

questions.question: What conclusion does the traveler reach from the Prophet’s qualities and miracles?
questions.answer: He concludes that the Prophet must be the most truthful of people and far above lying or cheating.

questions.question: In this passage, how does the traveler speak to himself?
questions.answer: He speaks to his own mind and reasons with it.

questions.question: Who is called the most celebrated creature in the passage?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What does the passage say about his speech and intelligence?
questions.answer: It presents him as the highest in speech and the most brilliant in mind.

questions.question: What long-lasting effect is credited to him?
questions.answer: He is said to have enlightened fourteen centuries.

questions.question: What role did the Qur’an play in that influence?
questions.answer: The Qur’an was part of the light through which that influence spread.

questions.question: How did the traveler view the Prophet’s time period after imagining it?
questions.answer: He saw it as a deeply blessed time full of happiness.

questions.question: What social result is mentioned to show the strength of the Prophet’s guidance?
questions.answer: People who had been very undeveloped became leaders and teachers.

questions.question: What did the traveler want to verify first about the Prophet’s message?
questions.answer: He wanted to make sure the Prophet’s words and warnings were fully true.

questions.question: How is the evidence for his character strengthened in the passage?
questions.answer: It is strengthened by saying even his enemies recognized his virtues.

questions.question: What is one miracle involving the sky?
questions.answer: The moon was split.

questions.question: What is one miracle involving battle?
questions.answer: A thrown handful of dust reached the enemy and helped drive them back.

questions.question: What is one miracle involving water?
questions.answer: Water came from his fingers for the army to drink.

questions.question: What moral lesson does the traveler draw from all this evidence?
questions.answer: A person with such high character and such signs from Allah would never stoop to lies, fraud, or serious error.

questions.question: What was the traveler looking for through the created world?
questions.answer: He was seeking knowledge of his Lord and Creator.

questions.question: Why does the passage place the Prophet before other creatures in this search?
questions.answer: Because he is presented as the greatest guide among them.

questions.question: What phrase in the passage shows that the Prophet’s greatness was widely recognized?
questions.answer: It says even his enemies testified to it.

questions.question: Besides being a ruler-like leader, what other strengths are especially mentioned?
questions.answer: His powerful speech and remarkable intelligence are especially mentioned.

questions.question: What two things are said to have illuminated many centuries?
questions.answer: His excellence and the Qur’an.

questions.question: How did the traveler describe the Prophet’s era after entering it mentally?
questions.answer: He described it as an age of true joy and blessing.

questions.question: What educational and civilizational change is described?
questions.answer: A people seen as primitive and illiterate became world teachers and leaders.

questions.question: What was the traveler’s first step in checking the Prophet’s message?
questions.answer: He began by examining the Prophet’s worth and the truthfulness of what he said.

questions.question: How many broad proofs are mentioned in total?
questions.answer: Nine are mentioned.

questions.question: What is the first broad proof built on?
questions.answer: It is built on the Prophet’s noble traits and the miracles shown through him.

questions.question: Why is the agreement of many reporters important for miracle reports in this passage?
questions.answer: It shows the reports are too widely confirmed to dismiss as doubtful.

questions.question: Which miracle in the passage gave immediate help to thirsty people?
questions.answer: Water flowing from his fingers helped the thirsty army.

questions.question: Which miracle in the passage affected the enemy in battle?
questions.answer: The thrown dust reached their eyes and caused them to run.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest about the connection between noble character and truthfulness?
questions.answer: It suggests that a person with the highest moral character does not act with lies and deception.

questions.question: What final judgment does the traveler make about the Prophet’s honesty?
questions.answer: He judges that falsehood, trickery, and low behavior are impossible for him.

questions.question: What did the traveler say to his intellect at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: He said that in searching for his Creator through creation, he should first go to the greatest and most famous of creatures.

questions.question: Which human being is presented as the best guide for that search?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: How does the passage show that his greatness was not only accepted by followers?
questions.answer: It says even opponents recognized his rank.

questions.question: What two abilities of the Prophet are highlighted along with his leadership?
questions.answer: His eloquence and his sharp intellect are highlighted.

questions.question: What shows the lasting reach of his mission?
questions.answer: The passage says he brightened fourteen centuries.

questions.question: Why did the traveler see the Prophet’s time as a blessed age?
questions.answer: Because the Prophet’s presence and message filled it with goodness and happiness.

questions.question: What happened to the people who first received his message?
questions.answer: They changed from a backward and unlettered people into leaders and teachers.

questions.question: What was the traveler careful to examine before asking about Allah?
questions.answer: He wanted to be sure of the Prophet’s value and complete honesty.

questions.question: What main subjects appear in the first proof?
questions.answer: The first proof includes his excellent character and the miracles granted to him.

questions.question: What miracle involved a gesture toward the moon?
questions.answer: The moon was split with the pointing of his finger.

questions.question: What miracle involved a small amount of material in battle?
questions.answer: A handful of dust became a cause of the enemy’s defeat and retreat.

questions.question: What miracle involved meeting the army’s physical need?
questions.answer: Water came from his fingers so the army could drink.

questions.question: Why does the passage point readers to another work about the miracles?
questions.answer: Because that work explains many more miracles with detailed evidence.

questions.question: Based on the first proof, what kind of person does the traveler believe the Prophet must be?
questions.answer: He believes he must be the most truthful of people, completely free from deceit and falsehood.

questions.question: What was the traveler trying to discover in this passage?
questions.answer: He was trying to discover his Master and Creator.

questions.question: Through what means was he making this discovery?
questions.answer: He was using the signs found in created beings.

questions.question: Why was Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, chosen as the first guide to consult?
questions.answer: Because he was seen as the greatest, most accomplished, and most widely acknowledged among creation.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Prophet’s reputation among enemies?
questions.answer: It says even they bore witness to his greatness.

questions.question: What qualities made him especially fit to guide others?
questions.answer: His leadership, powerful speech, and brilliant understanding made him especially fit.

questions.question: What long period of time is said to have been brightened by him?
questions.answer: Fourteen centuries.

questions.question: What made the age of the Prophet look like an age of happiness to the traveler?
questions.answer: The Prophet’s light and guidance made it so.

questions.question: What proof from human history is given for the power of that guidance?
questions.answer: A people once seen as uncultured and uneducated became leading teachers of the world.

questions.question: What did the traveler say should be known before asking about the Creator?
questions.answer: The Prophet’s true rank and the trustworthiness of his speech should be known first.

questions.question: How many major proofs are mentioned, even though only one is detailed here?
questions.answer: Nine major proofs are mentioned.

questions.question: What does the first proof say about the Prophet’s character?
questions.answer: It says the best moral traits were gathered in him.

questions.question: What are the three sample miracles named in the passage?
questions.answer: The splitting of the moon, the dust affecting the enemy, and water flowing from his fingers.

questions.question: What is the purpose of mentioning Qur’anic verses and mass-transmitted reports with the miracles?
questions.answer: It is to show that these miracles have strong support and are not random stories.

questions.question: According to the traveler, what kinds of actions are beneath such a person?
questions.answer: Lying, cheating, and falling into falsehood or error are beneath him.

questions.question: What central conclusion does this whole passage lead to about the Prophet?
questions.answer: It leads to the conclusion that he is a completely trustworthy messenger and a true guide to knowing Allah.
